items.title: Grief-stricken mother of star footballer reveals AFL executive phone call
items.description: West Coast Eagles star Adam Hunter's mother Joanne Brown says AFL executive Laura Kane reached out to her, but the grieving mother says the phone call was "too little, too late".

items.title: NSW confirms its first cases of bird flu in Australian natives
items.description: The New South Wales government has confirmed the state's first cases of H5 avian influenza in Australian native birds.

items.title: Trump announces $560m critical minerals investment in tiny NSW town
items.description: The Pentagon is investing more than half a billion dollars to expand an Australian critical mineral project poised to become the world's first scandium mine.

items.title: Death of model forces difficult conversation about divorce in India
items.description: Divorce is still frowned upon in India, where women face immense pressure to stay in toxic relationships.

items.title: Gina Rinehart says ABC Ombudsman finding 'fails all Australian women'
items.description: The mining magnate says the ABC's Editorial Standards need "significant improvement" after a video describing a fictional scenario that involved a violent attack on her was aired on Race Around the World.

items.title: 'Never seen anything like this': Britain's parks and pastures turn brown
items.description: London's parks turn brown and British farmers battle to salvage what is left of their produce as a drought grips multiple parts of the country.

items.title: Live: Dolphins look to seal finals spot in crucial battle of Brisbane
items.description: The Dolphins can secure a NRL finals spot with a victory over cross-town rival Brisbane at Lang Park. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Smith active as Cats jump Dons, Swans on top of Port after slow start
items.description: Geelong looks to shrug off a week of controversy as it hosts Essendon at Kardinia Park, while Sydney attempts to cement a top-two spot on the ladder with win over Port Adelaide at the SCG. Follow live.

items.title: Tokyo had 13,000 geisha in 1940. That number has plummeted

items.title: The Iran war has 'metastasised', and that suits one side just fine

items.title: 'Once-in-a-lifetime' discovery found in a cave hidden beneath a paddock
items.description: There are very few places on Earth that remain untouched and unseen by humans. For true explorers, the final frontier is not a distant speck in the sky, it is the underground realm beneath our feet.

items.title: Dogs to be euthanased after man's death in suspected attack
items.description: Dogs suspected of mauling a man to death at a distinctive large home in south-west Sydney will be euthanased, after also injuring a council worker.

items.description: Police charge a 45-year-old who allegedly got out of his car and smashed several stationary vehicles, before leading officers on a wild chase through Perth's northern suburbs.

items.description: This stew uses cheap ingredients to create a delicious, nourishing midweek meal.

items.title: The unexpected day jobs of Australia's female footballers

items.title: Retro game pinging, popping and buzzing as new generation has a ball
items.description: Tash Anderson has become Australia's top female pinball competitor since being roped into attending a social event three years ago.

items.title: Rockliff adviser, ex-minister chosen as Liberal Senate replacements

items.title: What is the 'singles tax' and is it real?
items.description: The singles tax has nothing to do with the ATO, it's the extra people pay when they can't split costs like rent, internet, insurance and other household bills the way couples can.

items.title: Experts concerned Australians may be using unnecessary prenatal supplements
items.description: Health experts are concerned social media influencers are marketing unnecessary supplements to parents that are either ineffective or may cause harm.  Here's what is recommended during pregnancy.

items.title: Deliberately misleading party name approved for Victorian election
items.description: A political party with a deliberately misleading name has been successfully registered for the Victorian election, aiming to redirect left-wing votes towards parties on the right.

items.title: David Brat confirmed as US ambassador to Australia
items.description: After nearly 20 months of the role being vacant, the Trump administration has confirmed the appointment of a former Republican congressman as ambassador to Australia.

items.title: US yen intervention blindsides Europe, puts global economy on alert
items.description: Global economic policy now seems at the mercy of an exceptionally casual approach to information, scribbled on a notepad, awaiting an update on Scott Bessent's to-do list.
